title: Penniston touches craft and receives binary code

tellings.quote: he stated that he touched the surface of the craft noting smooth glass-like material and unusual symbols etched on its side that resembled hieroglyphs according to peneston he experienced a profound telepathic download of binary code after touching the craft

plain: In 1980, in Rendlesham Forest in England, a serviceman named Jim Penniston is said to have walked up to a landed craft and touched it, finding a smooth, glass-like surface with strange symbols etched on its side that looked like hieroglyphs. According to Penniston, touching it gave him a sudden telepathic "download" of binary code, the ones and zeros computers use. Michels relays Penniston's account on an episode about UFOs near nuclear bases, a story that, if true, would mean a craft passed a message straight into a man's mind.
